featured.headline: Cops Are Using Flock to Spy on People for the Crime of Standing Around
featured.dek: Law enforcement agencies across the country are deploying Flock surveillance systems to monitor citizens with little oversight, a program that has expanded under both Republican and Democrat administrations.
